Standing (left to right) Gerry North, Gordon Biscoe, Bill Laws, Brian Pritchard, Tom Osment, Maureen Pritchard, Zara Chidoub, Mark Pollard, Jonathan Blackledge, Janet Blackledge, Mike Blackledge, Neil Speaight, Alan Mead, Padraic Buckley, Paul Freary, Eric Hall, Pete Willis, Hazel Mead.
